subject.name: Computer Science
subject.description: Foundations of programming and computational thinking, taught in English.
subject.description_fr: Fondamentaux de la programmation, en anglais.

chapters.title: Getting Started with Python
chapters.description: Why Python, first program, and the idea of algorithms.

lessons.title: What Is an Algorithm?
lessons.objective_en: Define an algorithm, describe everyday tasks step by step, know why order of instructions matters.

lessons.title: Your First Python Program
lessons.objective_en: Write and run a Hello World program, understand print(), basic input via input(), and what an interpreter does.

lessons.title: Variables, Strings and Numbers
lessons.objective_en: Create variables, use str/int/float types, convert between types, format output with f-strings.

lessons.title: Operators and Boolean Logic
lessons.objective_en: Use arithmetic and comparison operators, combine conditions with and/or/not.

lessons.title: If / Elif / Else
lessons.objective_en: Write conditional branches, nest conditions, avoid common pitfalls (else alignment, == vs =).

lessons.title: For and While Loops
lessons.objective_en: Repeat actions with for and while, use range(), break and continue, avoid infinite loops.

lessons.title: Defining and Calling Functions
lessons.objective_en: Define functions with def, use parameters and return values, understand scope of variables.

lessons.title: Lists, Tuples and Dictionaries
lessons.objective_en: Store collections of data, slice lists, iterate over dictionaries, choose the right structure.

chapters.title: Problem Solving Project
chapters.description: Building a small program from scratch.

lessons.title: Mini-Project: Grade Calculator
lessons.objective_en: Build a program that takes marks from to user, computes an average, and prints a grade (A to F) with feedback.
